note: Ein Stegosaurus-Bulle lebt laut Profil oft von Natur aus allein und zieht auf bekannten Pfaden umher. Das ist das Spitzmaulnashorn pur. Das Zebra steht nur noch für die Zeal, die er sucht.

analogs.covers: Solo bull: a grumpy, solitary tank that walks its known paths, never runs and drives off anything near its bush
The goal: a zeal of females he can win from another stallion

solo.headline: A lone black rhino bull on his known paths: grumpy, armoured, never fleeing, and always looking for a zeal whose bull he can challenge.
solo.playsLike: Solo you are best played as a bull, often alone by nature. You walk well-known paths between the instinctual nesting locations, hoping to meet a zeal whose male you can challenge for his females. Brothers may loosely follow each other for a while, but never defend each other and fight over any females they meet. You never flee, you chase threats away, and you claim the bush or water you are standing at.

why.text: “A male, oftentimes alone by nature, travels these paths anyway, seeking suitable females for his future harem.” Black rhino bulls live alone too.
When solitary, Stegosaurus migrate between instinctual nesting locations along well-known paths, as rhinos use the same trails for years.
Brothers may follow each other un-grouped for a while, “but will never defend the other”.
Aggressive to almost every other species and never runs from a fight, the black rhino's reputation in full.

notLike: Black rhinos are loners for life; a Stegosaurus bull is alone only until he wins a zeal.
solo.summary: Solo bist du am besten ein Bulle, ein mürrisches Spitzmaulnashorn auf seinen bekannten Pfaden. Männchen leben oft von Natur aus allein und wandern zwischen den Nistplätzen, immer auf der Suche nach einer Zeal, deren Bullen sie herausfordern können. Brüder laufen dir vielleicht eine Weile hinterher, aber verteidigen dich nie. Du fliehst nie, jagst Bedrohungen davon und beanspruchst den Busch oder das Wasser, an dem du stehst. Du brauchst niemanden, bis du deine eigenen Weibchen hast.
